decisions.statement: An account that has spent its seven-day window has spent its five-hour window.
The five-hour usage is worked out from the effective seven-day usage rather than the stated percent.
An account whose subscription is withdrawn has spent the whole of the window.
An account with no percent is worked out as no reading rather than as zero.
A percent stated as text is read as the number that percent spells.
No code outside the effective five-hour usage works out the five-hour spend.

definition: how much of the five-hour allowance is spent, a withdrawn or spent week counting as all of it
